title: Primary Bronchial Hybrid Low-Grade Fibromyxoid Sarcoma/Sclerosing Epithelioid Fibrosarcoma With EWSR1::CREB3L1 Fusion: Diagnostic Insights From a Challenging Case in the Respiratory Tract.
snippet: Hybrid low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma/sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma (LGFMS/SEF) is an ultra-rare fibroblastic sarcoma that typically arises in the soft tissues.
